newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen doing 2-day system RPs, no action possible.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen doing 2-day system RPs, no action possible.

text.p: The Federal Reserve will likely inject reserves into the banking system on Monday via two-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

Analysts forecast a $4.5 billion to $6.0 billion add need in the current maintenance period, which ends January 29. The Fed last added reserves on Thursday through overnight system RPs and $6.5 billion, 6-day system RPs executed.
Most said that since the add need is skewed more to the first half of the period, the Fed needs to add reserves this session even as the fed funds rate trades at 5-1/4 percent.
But some argued that Thursday's operation will cover the add need through Tuesday. ((-- N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1867))
